			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx_qtd end time_weighted_return_fx_qtd
			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_3m_roll_rc end time_weighted_return_3m_roll_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_3m_roll_lc end time_weighted_return_3m_roll_lc
			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx_3m_roll end time_weighted_return_fx_3m_roll
			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_fytd_rc end time_weighted_return_fytd_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fytd_lc end time_weighted_return_fytd_lc
			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx_fytd end time_weighted_return_fx_fytd
			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_1y_roll_rc end time_weighted_return_1y_roll_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc end time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc
			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx_1y_roll end time_weighted_return_fx_1y_roll
			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_4yp_rc end time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_4yp_lc end time_weighted_return_4yp_lc
			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx_4yp end time_weighted_return_fx_4yp
			, case when dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' then null else time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc end time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc
			, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc end time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc
			--, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' then null else time_weighted_return_fx_5y_roll end time_weighted_return_fx_5y_roll
			, last_update
		from 
			performance_dev.perf_bottom_up_monthly 
		where 
			(
				dataset_id in (
					/* CORE POOL */
					  'IPN_C'
					--, 'SAP_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'IPN_S'
					--, 'SAP_S'
				)
				and node_id = '2'
			)
			or
			(	/* TOTAL FUND */
				dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' )
				and "level" = 0
			)
			and periods_per_year = 12 -- pull monthly values only
	) base_pivot
	cross join unnest(
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_rc' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_lc'
			--, 'time_weighted_return_fx' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_qtd_rc' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_qtd_lc' 
			--, 'time_weighted_return_fx_qtd' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_3m_roll_rc' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_3m_roll_lc' 
			--, 'time_weighted_return_fx_3m_roll' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_fytd_rc' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_fytd_lc' 
			--, 'time_weighted_return_fx_fytd' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_1y_roll_rc' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc' 
			--, 'time_weighted_return_fx_1y_roll' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_4yp_rc' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_4yp_lc' 
			--, 'time_weighted_return_fx_4yp' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc' 
			--, 'time_weighted_return_fx_5y_roll'
		  ]
		/* VALUE */
		, array[
			  time_weighted_return_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_lc
			--, time_weighted_return_fx 
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_lc 
			--, time_weighted_return_fx_qtd 
			, time_weighted_return_3m_roll_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_3m_roll_lc 
			--, time_weighted_return_fx_3m_roll 
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_lc 
			--, time_weighted_return_fx_fytd 
			, time_weighted_return_1y_roll_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc 
			--, time_weighted_return_fx_1y_roll 
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc 
			--, time_weighted_return_fx_4yp 
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc 
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc 
			--, time_weighted_return_fx_5y_roll 
		  ]
	) unpivot ( metric, value )
), inv_select_dept_ex_tfm as (
	select
		  dataset_id
		, business_date
		, "level"
		, node_name
		, 'Local' as currency
		, case
			when metric like '%qtd%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%3m_roll%' then '3M'
			when metric like '%fytd%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%1y_roll%' then '1Y'
			when metric like '%4yp%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%5y_roll%' then '5Y'
			else 'MTD'
		  end period
		, value
		, last_update
	from (		
		select
			  dataset_id 
			, business_date 
			, "level" 
			, node_name 
			, contribution_fytd_lc 
			, contribution_4yp_lc
			, contribution_5y_roll_lc 
			, last_update 
		from 
			performance_dev.perf_top_down_monthly 
		where 
			dataset_id = 'SEC_SELECT_C'
			and "level" = 2
			and node_name != 'Total Fund Management'
	) inv_select_dept_ex_tfm_pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array [
			  'contribution_fytd_lc'
			, 'contribution_4yp_lc'
			, 'contribution_5y_roll_lc'
		]
		/* VALUE */
		, array [
			  contribution_fytd_lc 
			, contribution_4yp_lc
			, contribution_5y_roll_lc 
		]
	) inv_select_dept_ex_tfm_unpivot ( metric, value )
), inv_select_dept_tfm as (
	select 
		  'SEC_SELECT_C' as dataset_id
		, inv_select.business_date
		, 2 as "level"
		, 'Total Fund Management' as node_name
		, 'Local' as currency
		, inv_select.period
		--, inv_select.value as inv_select_value
		--, dept_contr.value as dept_contr_value
		, inv_select.value - dept_contr.value as value
		, greatest( inv_select.last_update, dept_contr.last_update ) as last_update
	from (
		/* Investment Selection */
		select *
		from 
			base
		where
			dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_C'
			and currency = 'CAD'
	) inv_select
	inner join (
		/* Dept Contribution ex TFM */
		select
			  dataset_id
			, business_date
			, "level"
			, currency
			, period
			, sum( value ) as value
			, max( last_update ) as last_update
		from
			inv_select_dept_ex_tfm
		group by 
			  dataset_id
			, business_date
			, "level"
			, currency
			, period
	) dept_contr
		on inv_select.business_date = dept_contr.business_date
		and inv_select.period = dept_contr.period
), cmb as (
	select
		  business_date
		, dataset_id
		, metric_group_l1
		, case 
				when currency = 'FX' then (
					case
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						else metric_friendly_name
					end
				)
				when currency = 'CAD' then (
					case
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						else metric_friendly_name
					end
				)
				when currency = 'Local' then (
					case 
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^LEVERAGE_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'ATP_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sRPL__(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^STGY_COMP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SEC_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
						else metric_friendly_name
					end
				)
				else metric_friendly_name
		  end metric_group_l2
		, metric
		, metric_friendly_name
		, "level"
		, investment_structure_l2
		, metric_friendly_name as attribution_node
		, currency
		, period
		, value
		, last_update
	from (
		select
			  business_date 
			, dataset_id
			, case 
				/* Headline Attribution */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'RISK_APP_TF'
					, 'DIV_LVG_TF'
					, 'INV_SELECT_TF'
					, 'DIV_LVG_TF + INV_SELECT_TF'
					, 'IPN_TF - MRP_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'RISK_APP_C'
					, 'DIV_LVG_C'
					, 'INV_SELECT_C'
					, 'DIV_LVG_C + INV_SELECT_C'
					, 'IPN_C - MRP_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'RISK_APP_S'
					, 'DIV_LVG_S'
					, 'INV_SELECT_S'
					, 'DIV_LVG_S + INV_SELECT_S'
					, 'IPN_S - MRP_S'
				)
				and currency = 'CAD'
				then 'Headline Attribution'
				/* Mainline Attribution */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'LEVERAGE_TF'
					, 'ATP_TF - RPL_TF'
					, 'STGY_COMP_TF'
					, 'SEC_SELECT_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'LEVERAGE_C'
					, 'ATP_C - RPL_C'
					, 'STGY_COMP_C'
					, 'SEC_SELECT_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'LEVERAGE_S'
					, 'ATP_S - RPL_S'
					, 'STGY_COMP_S'
					, 'SEC_SELECT_S'
				)
				and currency = 'Local' 
				then 'Mainline Attribution'
				/* Mainline Attribution FX */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'DIV_LVG_TF'
					, 'INV_SELECT_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'DIV_LVG_C'
					, 'INV_SELECT_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'DIV_LVG_S'
					, 'INV_SELECT_S'
				)
				and currency = 'FX'
				then 'Mainline Attribution'
				/* Portfolio Returns */
				when dataset_id in (
					/* TOTAL FUND */
					  'MRP_TF'
					, 'RP_TF'
					, 'ATP_TF'
					, 'RPL_TF'
					, 'SAP_TF'
					, 'IPN_TF'
					/* CORE POOL */
					, 'MRP_C'
					, 'RP_C'
					, 'ATP_C'
					, 'RPL_C'
					, 'SAP_C'
					, 'IPN_C'
					/* SUPP POOL */
					, 'MRP_S'
					, 'RP_S'
					, 'ATP_S'
					, 'RPL_S'
					, 'SAP_S'
					, 'IPN_S'
				)
				then 'Portfolio Returns'
			  end metric_group_l1
			, case 
					when currency = 'FX' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'BP FX - RP FX' /*'ATP FX - RP FX'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP FX - BP FX' /*'IP FX - ATP FX'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '(^MRP_(TF|C|S)$)|(^RP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^ATP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^RPL_(TF|S|C)$)|(^SAP_(TF|S|C)$)' ) then replace( replace( regexp_extract( dataset_id, '.*\_' ), 'ATP', 'BP' ), '_', ' FX' )
						end
					)
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '(^MRP_(TF|C|S)$)|(^RP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^ATP_(TF|S|C)$)|(^RPL_(TF|S|C)$)|(^SAP_(TF|S|C)$)' ) THEN replace( replace( regexp_extract( dataset_id, '.*\_' ), 'ATP', 'BP' ), '_', '' )
					when currency = 'CAD' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RISK_APP_(TF|C|S)$' ) THEN 'RP - MRP'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'BP - RP' /*'ATP - RP'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP - BP' /*'IP - ATP'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)\s\+\sINV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'IP - RP'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'IPN_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sMRP_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'IP - MRP'
						end
					)
					when currency = 'Local' then (
						case 
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^LEVERAGE_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'RPL - RP'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'ATP_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sRPL__(TF|C|S)' ) then 'BP - RPL' /*'ATP - RPL'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^STGY_COMP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'SAP - BP' /*'SAP - ATP'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SEC_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'IP - SAP'
						end
					)
			  end metric
			, case 
					when currency = 'FX' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Currency (Diversification & Leverage)'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Currency (Investment Selection)'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^MRP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Minimum Return Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Reference Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^ATP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Benchmark Portfolio FX' /*'Annual Target Portfolio FX'*/
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RPL_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Leveraged Reference Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SAP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Strategy Alternative Portfolio FX'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Portfolio FX'
						end
					)
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^MRP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Minimum Return Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Reference Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^ATP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Benchmark Portfolio' /*'Annual Target Portfolio'*/
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RPL_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Leveraged Reference Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SAP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Strategy Alternative Portfolio'
					when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^IPN_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Portfolio'
					when currency = 'CAD' then (
						case
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^RISK_APP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Risk Appetite'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Diversification & Leverage'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^INV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Investment Selection'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'DIV_LVG_(TF|C|S)\s\+\sINV_SELECT_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Value-Added (IP - RP)' 
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'IPN_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sMRP_(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Incremental Return (IP - MRP)' 
						end
					)
					when currency = 'Local' then (
						case 
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^LEVERAGE_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Leverage'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, 'ATP_(TF|C|S)\s\-\sRPL__(TF|C|S)' ) then 'Diversification'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^STGY_COMP_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Strategy Composition'
							when regexp_like( dataset_id, '^SEC_SELECT_(TF|C|S)$' ) then 'Security Selection'
						end
					)
			  end metric_friendly_name
			, "level"
			, node_name as investment_structure_l2
			, currency
			, period
			, value
			, last_update
		from (
			select * from base
			union all
			select * from inv_select_dept_ex_tfm
			union all
			select * from inv_select_dept_tfm
		) combined
	) combined_mapped
), cmb_filtered as (
	select 	*
	from 	cmb
	where 	metric_group_l1 is not null
			and business_date = date_trunc('month', business_date) + interval '1' month - interval '1' day -- pull month-end dates only
			and not ( period in ( 'MTD', 'QTD', '3M', 'FYTD' ) and business_date < cast( '2015-06-30' as date ) ) -- MTD, QTD, 3M, FYTD values prior to 2015-06-30 are invalid
			and not ( period in ( '1Y' ) and business_date < cast( '2016-04-30' as date ) ) -- 1Y values prior to 2016-04-30 are invalid
			and not ( period in ( '4Y+FYTD', '5Y' ) and business_date < cast( '2020-03-31' as date ) ) -- 5Y values prior to 2020-03-31 are invalid
			and value is not null
), cmb_filtered_final as (
	/* Adding columns needed specifically for QuickSight dashboard due to limitations */
	select
		  cmb_filtered.*
		, format( '%1$tY-%1$tm', business_date ) as year_month
		, case
			when period = 'MTD' then '1. MTD'
			when period = 'QTD' then '2. QTD'
			when period = '3M' then '3. 3M'
			when period = 'FYTD' then '4. FYTD'
			when period = '1Y' then '5. 1Y'
			when period = '4Y+FYTD' then '6. 4Y+FYTD'
			when period = '5Y' then '7. 5Y'
		  end period_sorted
	from 
		cmb_filtered
)
select * from cmb_filtered_final) AS "finsights_perf_attribution_DEV"

SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			wafprodcloudformationstac_ispj5m.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND (
			(day = 12 AND hour >= 23)
			OR (day = 13 AND hour <= 00)
		)

	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-12 23:55:24'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

/* cppi::cbf2439e0d11e87eb665cc8fed9ab09a80001e35782371ff688a474dc4cb14f1 */
WITH RankedTransactions AS (
    SELECT *,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY model_portfolio_id, 
		                	abor_security_number, 
		                	abor_transaction_number,
		                	scd_transaction_number_primary_key, -- same transaction number can have different primary key
		                	elementary_transaction_code
						order by
							changed_date desc -- change date is actual loaded date so use this to get the latest data.
           ) AS rn
    FROM trades_deals.scd_transactions
    WHERE accounting_framework_id = 'PCLFWKMAIN'
),
JoinedData AS (
    SELECT st.*
    FROM RankedTransactions st
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY abor_security_id ORDER BY business_date DESC) AS rn
        FROM asset.enterprise_security
    ) es ON st.abor_security_id = es.abor_security_id AND es.rn = 1
    LEFT JOIN reference.scd_model_portfolio smp 
        ON smp.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio)
        AND st.model_portfolio_id = smp.model_portfolio_id
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY scd_party_id ORDER BY business_date DESC) AS rn
        FROM party.enterprise_party
    ) ep ON st.counterparty_id = ep.scd_party_id AND ep.rn = 1
    LEFT JOIN reference.scd_securities ss 
        ON st.abor_security_number = ss.abor_security_number
        AND ss.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.scd_securities)
    LEFT JOIN reference.reference_exchange_codes rec 
        ON es.esm_exchange_name = rec.exchange_name
        and es.mic = rec.mic
		and es.esm_exchange_name != 'UNKNOWN'
        AND rec.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.reference_exchange_codes)
    LEFT JOIN reference.reference_country_codes rcc_exchange_country 
        ON es.esm_country_code = rcc_exchange_country.country_code
        AND rcc_exchange_country.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.reference_country_codes)
    LEFT JOIN reference.reference_country_codes rcc_incorp_country 
        ON es.esm_incorp_country_code = rcc_incorp_country.country_code
        AND rcc_incorp_country.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.reference_country_codes)
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY portfolio_id ORDER BY business_date DESC) AS latest
        FROM reference.scd_portfolio
    ) sp ON sp.latest = 1 AND sp.portfolio_id = st.portfolio_id
    LEFT JOIN reference.reference_country_codes rcc_trade_country 
        ON rec.country_ref_code = rcc_trade_country.country_code
        AND rcc_trade_country.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.reference_country_codes)
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT 
            abor_transaction_number,
            business_date,
            transaction_cancellation_flag,
            trade_date,
            abor_cost_tax_quotation_currency,
            amount_quotation_currency AS other_costs_in_payment_quotation_currency,
            abor_cost_tax_portfolio_currency,
            amount_portfolio_currency AS other_costs_in_payment_portfolio_currency,
            (CASE WHEN abor_cost_type = 'Coupon/dividend tax' THEN amount_portfolio_currency ELSE 0 END) AS coupon_dividend_tax_portfolio_currency,
            (CASE WHEN abor_cost_type = 'Coupon/dividend tax' THEN amount_quotation_currency ELSE 0 END) AS coupon_dividend_tax_quotation_currency,
            (CASE WHEN abor_cost_type = 'Coupon/dividend tax' THEN amount_settlement_currency ELSE 0 END) AS coupon_dividend_tax_settlement_currency,
            (CASE WHEN abor_cost_type = 'Restitution expected' THEN amount_portfolio_currency ELSE 0 END) AS restitution_expected_portfolio_currency,
            (CASE WHEN abor_cost_type = 'Restitution expected' THEN amount_quotation_currency ELSE 0 END) AS restitution_expected_quotation_currency,
            (CASE WHEN abor_cost_type = 'Restitution expected' THEN amount_settlement_currency ELSE 0 END) AS restitution_expected_settlement_currency,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY abor_transaction_number
                ORDER BY business_date DESC
            ) AS latest
        FROM trades_deals.scd_transaction_cost
        WHERE transaction_cancellation_flag = 'Active'
    ) stc
    ON stc.latest = 1
       AND st.abor_transaction_number = stc.abor_transaction_number
       AND st.transaction_cancellation_flag = stc.transaction_cancellation_flag
       AND st.trade_date = stc.trade_date
    LEFT JOIN reference.reference_currency_codes rcc 
        ON st.quotation_currency = rcc.currency_code
        AND rcc.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.reference_currency_codes)

/* QuickSight 0344831d-8e5a-47dc-ab02-1f6db12314ef */
SELECT "business_date" AS "d190c12d-ef31-4e95-b56f-92fc0d3c4941.business_date", "node" AS "d190c12d-ef31-4e95-b56f-92fc0d3c4941.node", "PV" AS "d190c12d-ef31-4e95-b56f-92fc0d3c4941.PV", "10 Year Volatility" AS "d190c12d-ef31-4e95-b56f-92fc0d3c4941.10 Year Volatility", "10 Year VaR" AS "d190c12d-ef31-4e95-b56f-92fc0d3c4941.10 Year VaR", "10 Year Expected Shortfall" AS "d190c12d-ef31-4e95-b56f-92fc0d3c4941.10 Year Expected Shortfall", "var_pct" AS "d190c12d-ef31-4e95-b56f-92fc0d3c4941.var_pct", "vol_pct" AS "d190c12d-ef31-4e95-b56f-92fc0d3c4941.vol_pct", "cvar_pct" AS "d190c12d-ef31-4e95-b56f-92fc0d3c4941.cvar_pct", "strategy_node" AS "d190c12d-ef31-4e95-b56f-92fc0d3c4941.strategy_node"
FROM (-- Step 1: Get program-level metrics
WITH program_data AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(business_date AS DATE) AS business_date,
    program AS node,

    -- Base values
    MAX(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'PV' THEN analytic_value END) AS PV,
    MAX(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'VOLATILITY_10YR' THEN analytic_value END) AS "10 Year Volatility",
    MAX(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'VAR_10YR' AND confidence_level = 0.95 THEN analytic_value END) AS "10 Year VaR",
    MAX(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'EXPECTED_SHORTFALL_10YR' AND confidence_level = 0.95 THEN analytic_value END) AS "10 Year Expected Shortfall",

    -- % Calculations (with null and zero checks)
    CASE 
      WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'PV' THEN analytic_value END) != 0 
           AND MAX(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'PV' THEN analytic_value END) IS NOT NULL
      THEN MAX(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'VAR_10YR' AND confidence_level = 0.95 THEN analytic_value END) 
           / MAX(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'PV' THEN analytic_value END)
      ELSE NULL
    END AS var_pct,

    CASE 
      WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'PV' THEN analytic_value END) != 0 
           AND MAX(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'PV' THEN analytic_value END) IS NOT NULL
      THEN MAX(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'VOLATILITY_10YR' THEN analytic_value END) 
           / MAX(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'PV' THEN analytic_value END)
      ELSE NULL
    END AS vol_pct,

    CASE 
      WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'PV' THEN analytic_value END) != 0 
           AND MAX(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'PV' THEN analytic_value END) IS NOT NULL
      THEN MAX(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'EXPECTED_SHORTFALL_10YR' AND confidence_level = 0.95 THEN analytic_value END) 
           / MAX(CASE WHEN analytic_type = 'PV' THEN analytic_value END)
      ELSE NULL
    END AS cvar_pct

  FROM risk_prod.rmv_analytics
  WHERE program IN ('Listed Real Estate', 'Listed Infrastructure', 'Listed SEG')
    AND hierarchy_level = 'PROGRAM'
    AND portfolio_type = 'IP'
    AND hierarchy_type = 'RISK'
    AND (
          analytic_type IN ('PV', 'VOLATILITY_10YR')
          OR (
             analytic_type IN ('VAR_10YR', 'EXPECTED_SHORTFALL_10YR')
             AND confidence_level = 0.95
          )
        )
    AND date_parse(business_date, '%Y-%m-%d') >= DATE '2023-06-30'
  GROUP BY CAST(business_date AS DATE), program
)

-- Step 2: Add strategy_node manually
SELECT 
  pd.*,
  CASE
    WHEN pd.node = 'Listed Real Estate' THEN 'Real Estate'
    WHEN pd.node = 'Listed Infrastructure' THEN 'Infrastructure'
    WHEN pd.node = 'Listed SEG' THEN 'Sustainable Energy Group'
    ELSE NULL
  END AS strategy_node
FROM program_data pd) AS "LRA- Radar Analytics"

			    date,
			    MAX(currencyToUsdRate) OVER (
				    PARTITION BY currencyCode,
				    grouped_usd,
				    data_diff
			    ) as currencyToUsdRate,
                MAX(currencyToCadRate) OVER (
                    PARTITION BY currencyCode,
                    grouped_cad,
                    data_diff
                ) as currencyToCadRate
			FROM (
				SELECT date,
					currencyCode,
					currencyToCadRate,
					currencyToUsdRate,
					COUNT(currencyToCadRate) OVER (
						PARTITION BY currencyCode
						ORDER BY date
					) as grouped_cad,
					COUNT(currencyToUsdRate) OVER (
						PARTITION BY currencyCode
						ORDER BY date
					) as grouped_usd,
					date - LAG(date, 3) OVER(
						PARTITION BY currencyCode
						ORDER BY date
					) as data_diff
				FROM (
						SELECT erc.data_date AS date,
								erc.currency AS currencyCode,
								erc.exchange_rate AS currencyToCadRate,
								erd.exchange_rate AS currencyToUsdRate,

with TX_BROKER AS ( select scd_transaction_account_key, max(broker_id) as broker_id
FROM (SELECT scd_transaction_account_key, broker_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY scd_transaction_number_primary_key
            ORDER BY extract_time DESC

    FROM trades_deals.scd_transactions

  where row_numb = 1
group by scd_transaction_account_key),

with TX_BROKER AS ( select scd_transaction_account_key, max(broker_id) as broker_id
FROM (SELECT scd_transaction_account_key, broker_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY scd_transaction_number_primary_key
            ORDER BY extract_time DESC
        ) AS row_numb
    FROM trades_deals.scd_transactions
    where scd_transaction_account_key is not null )
  where row_numb = 1
group by scd_transaction_account_key),
LATEST_MIC_EXCH AS ( select mic, cppib_exchange_id, exchange_name, country_ref_code, mic_name 
FROM (SELECT *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY mic

    where mic is not null )
  where row_numb = 1
)

FROM (SELECT scd_transaction_account_key, broker_id,

with TX_BROKER AS ( select scd_transaction_account_key, max(broker_id) as broker_id
FROM (SELECT scd_transaction_account_key, broker_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY scd_transaction_number_primary_key
            ORDER BY extract_time DESC

    FROM trades_deals.scd_transactions

  where row_numb = 1
group by scd_transaction_account_key),

        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (

FROM (SELECT scd_transaction_account_key, broker_id,

FROM (SELECT scd_transaction_account_key, broker_id,

with TX_BROKER AS ( select scd_transaction_account_key, max(broker_id) as broker_id
FROM (SELECT scd_transaction_account_key, broker_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY scd_transaction_number_primary_key
            ORDER BY extract_time DESC
        ) AS row_numb
    FROM trades_deals.scd_transactions
    where scd_transaction_account_key is not null )
  where row_numb = 1
group by scd_transaction_account_key),
LATEST_MIC_EXCH AS ( select mic, cppib_exchange_id, exchange_name, country_ref_code, mic_name

        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (

with TX_BROKER AS ( select scd_transaction_account_key, max(broker_id) as broker_id
FROM (SELECT scd_transaction_account_key, broker_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY scd_transaction_number_primary_key
            ORDER BY extract_time DESC
        ) AS row_numb
    FROM trades_deals.scd_transactions
    where scd_transaction_account_key is not null )
  where row_numb = 1
group by scd_transaction_account_key),
LATEST_MIC_EXCH AS ( select mic, cppib_exchange_id, exchange_name, country_ref_code, mic_name 
FROM (SELECT *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY mic
            ORDER BY CPPIB_EXCHANGE_ID ASC
        ) AS row_numb
    FROM reference.reference_exchange_codes
    where mic is not null )
  where row_numb = 1
)

with TX_BROKER AS ( select scd_transaction_account_key, max(broker_id) as broker_id
FROM (SELECT scd_transaction_account_key, broker_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY scd_transaction_number_primary_key
            ORDER BY extract_time DESC
        ) AS row_numb
    FROM trades_deals.scd_transactions
    where scd_transaction_account_key is not null )
  where row_numb = 1
group by scd_transaction_account_key),
LATEST_MIC_EXCH AS ( select mic, cppib_exchange_id, exchange_name, country_ref_code, mic_name 
FROM (SELECT *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY mic
            ORDER BY CPPIB_EXCHANGE_ID ASC
        ) AS row_numb
    FROM reference.reference_exchange_codes
    where mic is not null )
  where row_numb = 1
)

with TX_BROKER AS ( select scd_transaction_account_key, max(broker_id) as broker_id
FROM (SELECT scd_transaction_account_key, broker_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY scd_transaction_number_primary_key
            ORDER BY extract_time DESC
        ) AS row_numb
    FROM trades_deals.scd_transactions
    where scd_transaction_account_key is not null )
  where row_numb = 1
group by scd_transaction_account_key),
LATEST_MIC_EXCH AS ( select mic, cppib_exchange_id, exchange_name, country_ref_code, mic_name 
FROM (SELECT *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY mic
            ORDER BY CPPIB_EXCHANGE_ID ASC

  where row_numb = 1
)

group by scd_transaction_account_key),

	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (

			httprequest.clientip as client_ip,
			from_unixtime(timestamp/1000) as datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafnonprod_azf8db.waf_access_logs

		AND month = 06
		AND day = 13
		AND hour between 11 and 12
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-13 11:21:58'
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 10000.0
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC

		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM

	WHERE

) GROUP BY
	client_ip

	client_ip

	max_counter_per_min DESC

                                aa.strike_price/1000.0/bb.close_price as Mny
                                from market.om_option_price aa

                        on
                            bb.security_id=aa.security_id and bb.business_date = aa.business_date

                            aa.security_id = 110008

                            AND (

                                    WHEN aa.call_put_flag = 'C' THEN GREATEST(bb.close_price - aa.strike_price / 1000.0, 0)
                                    WHEN aa.call_put_flag = 'P' THEN GREATEST(aa.strike_price / 1000.0 - bb.close_price, 0)

                            )

          AND perf.market_value_quotation_currency IS NOT NULL

               model_portfolio,

        WHERE model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'

          AND InvestmentStructureLevel2 = 'Real Assets'
          AND (
                    InvestmentStructureLevel3 = 'Real Estate'
                AND InvestmentStructureLevel4 IN ('Listed Real Estate')
                AND InvestmentStructureLevel5 IN ('Listed Real Estate DM', 'Listed Real Estate EM')
                AND InvestmentStructureLevel6 IN ('Portfolio Enhancement DM', 'Portfolio Enhancement EM')
                AND model_portfolio NOT IN ('RIRELCP')

            )
          AND CAST(business_date AS DATE) IN (
                SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates
                UNION
                SELECT input_date      FROM input_dates
            )

    perf_data AS (
        SELECT
            perf.model_portfolio_id,
            perf.abor_security_id,
            perf.abor_security_number,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_quotation_currency
                END) AS market_value_qc_end,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT prev_trans_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_start,
            MAX(
                CASE
                    WHEN CAST(perf.business_date AS DATE) = (SELECT input_date FROM input_dates)
                        THEN perf.market_value_reporting_currency
                END) AS market_value_pc_end,
            asset.bloomberg_unique_id,
            asset.security_name,
            asset.bloomberg_code,
            mp.model_portfolio
        FROM performance_uat.scd_performance_calculation perf
        INNER JOIN listed_re_mp mp

        LEFT JOIN holdings_uat.abor_aa_real_assets asset
               ON perf.abor_security_id = asset.bloomberg_code

                        select

                        quotation_currency_code,

                        abor_security_id,

                        sum(COALESCE(dirty_value_portfolio_currency,0)) - sum(COALESCE(clean_value_portfolio_currency, 0)) as accrued_interest_end_of_period_portfolio_currency,

                        sum(COALESCE(clean_value_quotation_currency, 0)) as clean_value_quotation_currency,
                        sum(COALESCE(dirty_value_quotation_currency,0)) - sum(COALESCE(clean_value_quotation_currency, 0)) as accrued_interest_end_of_period_quotation_currency

                        from holdings.scd_holdings_main
                        where business_date >= '2025-03-31' and business_date <= '2025-06-12'
                        group by business_date, quotation_currency_code, model_portfolio_id, abor_security_id
                   
                    ), pnl as (
                    
                        select 
                            psl.business_date, --key
                            psl.aggregation_level_1 as model_portfolio_id, --key
                            psl.aggregation_level_2 as currency, --key
                            psl.aggregation_level_3 as abor_security_id, --key 

                            s.scd_security_key_id as abor_security_key_id,
                            s.cppib_sec_id, 		
                            
                            psl.aggregation_level_3_long_name as abor_security_name,
                            isi.level_2_nodename as "department",
                            isi.level_3_nodename as "signal",
                            isi.level_4_nodename as "invgroup",	

                            s.reporting_id_name,
                            s.abor_instrument_type_id, 
                            s.abor_security_group_name, 		
                            s.abor_security_type_name,
                                
                            case
                                WHEN s.country_of_exposure_code is not null then s.country_of_exposure_code
                                else s.abor_country_id
                            end as conutry_id,
                            
                            s.abor_quote_type, 
                            s.abor_quote_factor,
                                
                            --PC == reporting_currency == CAD
                            --QC == quotation_currency == Local
                            
                            LAG(psl.balance_nominal_number) over (partition by psl.aggregation_level_1, psl.aggregation_level_2, psl.aggregation_level_3 order by psl.business_date) as balance_start,
                            psl.balance_nominal_number as balance_end,
                                    
                            LAG(psl.clean_price) over (partition by psl.aggregation_level_1, psl.aggregation_level_2, psl.aggregation_level_3 order by psl.business_date) as cleanpx_start,
                            psl.clean_price as cleanpx_end,
                            
                            LAG(psl.dirty_price) over (partition by psl.aggregation_level_1, psl.aggregation_level_2, psl.aggregation_level_3 order by psl.business_date) as dirtypx_start,
                            psl.dirty_price as dirtypx_end,	
                            
                            LAG(psl.market_value_quotation_currency) over (partition by psl.aggregation_level_1, psl.aggregation_level_2, psl.aggregation_level_3 order by psl.business_date) as mtm_start_local, 
                            psl.market_value_quotation_currency as mtm_end_local,

                            psl.net_cash_flow_quotation_currency as net_cash_local,
                            psl.period_result_bottom_up_quotation_currency as pnl_local,
                           
                            LAG(psl.market_value_reporting_currency) over (partition by psl.aggregation_level_1, psl.aggregation_level_2, psl.aggregation_level_3 order by psl.business_date) as mtm_start_cad, 
                            psl.market_value_reporting_currency as mtm_end_cad,
                            
                            psl.net_cash_flow_reporting_currency as net_cash_cad,
                            psl.period_result_bottom_up_reporting_currency as pnl_cad,

                            CASE 
                                WHEN LAG(psl.fx_rate_quotation_currency_portfolio_currency) over (partition by psl.aggregation_level_1, psl.aggregation_level_2, psl.aggregation_level_3 order by psl.business_date) IS NULL THEN 0
                                ELSE LAG(psl.fx_rate_quotation_currency_portfolio_currency) over (partition by psl.aggregation_level_1, psl.aggregation_level_2, psl.aggregation_level_3 order by psl.business_date)
                            END as fx_start,

                            CASE 
                                WHEN psl.fx_rate_quotation_currency_portfolio_currency IS NULL THEN 0
                                ELSE psl.fx_rate_quotation_currency_portfolio_currency
                            END as fx_end,

                            LAG(mh.clean_value_quotation_currency) over (partition by psl.aggregation_level_1, psl.aggregation_level_2, psl.aggregation_level_3 order by psl.business_date) as cleanval_start_source,
                            mh.clean_value_quotation_currency as cleanval_end_source,

                            LAG(mh.accrued_interest_end_of_period_quotation_currency) over (partition by psl.aggregation_level_1, psl.aggregation_level_2, psl.aggregation_level_3 order by psl.business_date) as accrual_start_source,
                            mh.accrued_interest_end_of_period_quotation_currency as accrual_end_source,
                                
                            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY psl.aggregation_level_1, psl.aggregation_level_2, psl.aggregation_level_3 ORDER BY psl.business_date) AS row_num 
                            
                        from performance.scd_performance_seclvl psl

                        left join holdings mh on mh.abor_security_id = psl.aggregation_level_3 and mh.model_portfolio_id = psl.aggregation_level_1 and mh.quotation_currency_code = psl.aggregation_level_2 and mh.business_date = psl.business_date
                        left join reference.scd_securities s on s.abor_security_id = psl.aggregation_level_3 and s.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.scd_securities) --current pnl date
                        left join finance_accounting.v_investment_structure isi on psl.aggregation_level_1 = isi.id_model_portfolio  and isi.business_date = (select max(business_date) FROM finance_accounting.v_investment_structure) --current pnl date
                        where isi.level_2_nodename = 'Credit Investments' and psl.business_date >= '2025-03-31' and psl.business_date <= '2025-06-12' --previous pnl date TO GET the lag values
                )

                from pnl
                where business_date >= '2025-04-01' and business_date <= '2025-06-12' --ONLY pick up the CURRENT pnl date rows

                        model_portfolio_id,
                        abor_security_id,
                        sum(COALESCE(clean_value_portfolio_currency, 0)) as clean_value_portfolio_currency,
                        sum(COALESCE(dirty_value_portfolio_currency,0)) - sum(COALESCE(clean_value_portfolio_currency, 0)) as accrued_interest_end_of_period_portfolio_currency,

                        sum(COALESCE(clean_value_quotation_currency, 0)) as clean_value_quotation_currency,
                        sum(COALESCE(dirty_value_quotation_currency,0)) - sum(COALESCE(clean_value_quotation_currency, 0)) as accrued_interest_end_of_period_quotation_currency

                        from holdings.scd_holdings_main
                        where business_date >= '2025-03-31' and business_date <= '2025-06-12'
                        group by business_date, quotation_currency_code, model_portfolio_id, abor_security_id
                   
                    ), pnl as (
                    
                        select 
                            psl.business_date, --key
                            psl.aggregation_level_1 as model_portfolio_id, --key
                            psl.aggregation_level_2 as currency, --key
                            psl.aggregation_level_3 as abor_security_id, --key

                            psl.aggregation_level_3_long_name as abor_security_name,
                            isi.level_2_nodename as "department",
                            isi.level_3_nodename as "signal",
                            isi.level_4_nodename as "invgroup",	

                            s.reporting_id_name,
                            s.abor_instrument_type_id, 
                            s.abor_security_group_name, 		
                            s.abor_security_type_name,
                                
                            case
                                WHEN s.country_of_exposure_code is not null then s.country_of_exposure_code
                                else s.abor_country_id
                            end as conutry_id,
                            
                            s.abor_quote_type, 
                            s.abor_quote_factor,
                                
                            --PC == reporting_currency == CAD
                            --QC == quotation_currency == Local
                            
                            LAG(psl.balance_nominal_number) over (partition by psl.aggregation_level_1, psl.aggregation_level_2, psl.aggregation_level_3 order by psl.business_date) as balance_start,
                            psl.balance_nominal_number as balance_end,
                                    
                            LAG(psl.clean_price) over (partition by psl.aggregation_level_1, psl.aggregation_level_2, psl.aggregation_level_3 order by psl.business_date) as cleanpx_start,
                            psl.clean_price as cleanpx_end,
                            
                            LAG(psl.dirty_price) over (partition by psl.aggregation_level_1, psl.aggregation_level_2, psl.aggregation_level_3 order by psl.business_date) as dirtypx_start,
                            psl.dirty_price as dirtypx_end,	
                            
                            LAG(psl.market_value_quotation_currency) over (partition by psl.aggregation_level_1, psl.aggregation_level_2, psl.aggregation_level_3 order by psl.business_date) as mtm_start_local, 
                            psl.market_value_quotation_currency as mtm_end_local,

                            psl.net_cash_flow_quotation_currency as net_cash_local,
                            psl.period_result_bottom_up_quotation_currency as pnl_local,
                           
                            LAG(psl.market_value_reporting_currency) over (partition by psl.aggregation_level_1, psl.aggregation_level_2, psl.aggregation_level_3 order by psl.business_date) as mtm_start_cad, 
                            psl.market_value_reporting_currency as mtm_end_cad,
                            
                            psl.net_cash_flow_reporting_currency as net_cash_cad,
                            psl.period_result_bottom_up_reporting_currency as pnl_cad,

                            CASE 
                                WHEN LAG(psl.fx_rate_quotation_currency_portfolio_currency) over (partition by psl.aggregation_level_1, psl.aggregation_level_2, psl.aggregation_level_3 order by psl.business_date) IS NULL THEN 0
                                ELSE LAG(psl.fx_rate_quotation_currency_portfolio_currency) over (partition by psl.aggregation_level_1, psl.aggregation_level_2, psl.aggregation_level_3 order by psl.business_date)
                            END as fx_start,

                            CASE 
                                WHEN psl.fx_rate_quotation_currency_portfolio_currency IS NULL THEN 0
                                ELSE psl.fx_rate_quotation_currency_portfolio_currency
                            END as fx_end,

                            LAG(mh.clean_value_quotation_currency) over (partition by psl.aggregation_level_1, psl.aggregation_level_2, psl.aggregation_level_3 order by psl.business_date) as cleanval_start_source,
                            mh.clean_value_quotation_currency as cleanval_end_source,

                            LAG(mh.accrued_interest_end_of_period_quotation_currency) over (partition by psl.aggregation_level_1, psl.aggregation_level_2, psl.aggregation_level_3 order by psl.business_date) as accrual_start_source,
                            mh.accrued_interest_end_of_period_quotation_currency as accrual_end_source,
                                
                            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY psl.aggregation_level_1, psl.aggregation_level_2, psl.aggregation_level_3 ORDER BY psl.business_date) AS row_num 
                            
                        from performance.scd_performance_seclvl psl

                        left join holdings mh on mh.abor_security_id = psl.aggregation_level_3 and mh.model_portfolio_id = psl.aggregation_level_1 and mh.quotation_currency_code = psl.aggregation_level_2 and mh.business_date = psl.business_date
                        left join reference.scd_securities s on s.abor_security_id = psl.aggregation_level_3 and s.business_date = (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.scd_securities) --current pnl date
                        left join finance_accounting.v_investment_structure isi on psl.aggregation_level_1 = isi.id_model_portfolio  and isi.business_date = (select max(business_date) FROM finance_accounting.v_investment_structure) --current pnl date
                        where isi.level_2_nodename = 'Credit Investments' and psl.business_date >= '2025-03-31' and psl.business_date <= '2025-06-12' --previous pnl date TO GET the lag values
                )
